name: Repair Jammer - Armor
RelatedDescription: An engineering backpack fitted with a high-precision robotic arm that provides professional repairs on the battlefield. It can also affect the Armor of enemy STs.

61233.name: Repair Unit I - Armor
61233.SpecificEffects:
When the action starts, repair yourself <color=#F74848>once</color>, restoring HP equal to <color=#F74848>0.6x</color> the Manipulator's Repair AMT. This cannot repair damaged parts.
In combat, the enemy's Armor <color=#F74848>-50%</color>.
